features.intro: As a maneuver, a creature [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to a switch can make an **Agility test**.
features.name: Deactivate

tiers.high: The switch is deactivated and doesn't trigger.
tiers.mid: The switch is deactivated but the creature is [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (EoT).

features.body: A creature [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the switch uses a maneuver to trigger it.
features.name: Activate

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The linked mechanism is activated. A switch automatically resets and can be triggered repeatedly.

flavor: Set into any surface, this mechanism acts as a trigger for another linked mechanism.
name: Switch

stats.name: Link
stats.value: A switch is linked to another mechanism that it activates when triggered.
